words.sense: make a process proceed more quickly than normal
make a process easier to complete by reducing obstacles

edges.boundary_rule: Expedite changes how soon a task gets done; facilitate removes obstacles or makes the task easier, even without shortening its duration.

misconceptions.M3: Treating any useful help as speeding up.
